title: The Entire History of Ethiopia
brief: A natural, absorbing narrated history of Ethiopia, from Aksum through the November 2022 Pretoria agreement. Improve the opening's reversal and the story's connecting thread; make every scene advance a decision, consequence or change in power. Let the ending answer the opening without a slogan or subscription request. Use only real images and footage, preserve the whole source image, prefer widescreen compositions, and keep dates and other on-screen text minimal. Prioritize clear, warm, human-sounding narration over theatrical delivery.
